notes: Source manifest for the demo scenario asset pack (device-simulator plan, Phase 1). `scripts/build-scenario.mjs` rebuilds every scenario from these ids alone: it syncs the source objects from `sourceBucket` (read-only; run with `--source-profile xorgate-prod`), builds `demo-assets/v1/<id>/` and `catalog.json`. The privacy block records the Q11 decision per clip.

scenarios.title: Highway drive west
scenarios.description: 27-minute drive out of Toronto West onto the highway: sustained highway speeds with a few slowdowns and a run back through suburban streets.

privacy.notes: Reviewed 2 frames/fragment (54 frames) at 640px + full-res spot checks. Plates on cars stopped directly ahead at lights are legible at 1280x720 (e.g. a white BMW X3 and a red Hyundai around fragments 10-13); highway-distance plates are not. No identifiable faces. Q11-B (blur) deferred to the user: needs plate detection + re-encode and would break the byte-for-byte originals.

scenarios.title: Long fast drive toward Niagara
scenarios.description: 45-minute fast highway run from Toronto West toward the Niagara region: the longest and fastest lap in the pack.

privacy.notes: Reviewed 2 frames/fragment (91 frames) at 640px. Mostly highway-distance traffic into strong sun glare; a few plates at lights near the start (a Dodge Caravan) and parked cars in the village at the end are legible at 1280x720. One pedestrian at a plaza, not identifiable. Q11-B deferred to the user.

scenarios.title: City drive with stops
scenarios.description: 16-minute evening city drive with traffic-light stops and a short expressway stretch; the newest recording in the pack.

privacy.notes: Reviewed 2 frames/fragment (31 frames) at 640px. Cars stopped ahead at lights (a Honda Civic, a Hyundai Santa Fe) show legible plates at 1280x720; pedestrians at a crosswalk are small and not identifiable. Q11-B deferred to the user.

scenarios.title: Short stop-and-go urban
scenarios.description: 15-minute stop-and-go drive through residential and arterial streets; never faster than about 70 km/h.

privacy.notes: Reviewed 2 frames/fragment (30 frames) at 640px + two full-res frames. A white Subaru stopped ahead (fragment 7, ~20 s) has a clearly legible Ontario plate; a silver sedan at a light (fragment 10-11) too. No identifiable faces. Q11-B deferred to the user.

scenarios.title: Short neighbourhood drive
scenarios.description: 9-minute sunny afternoon drive from Toronto West along arterial roads past high-rises and through residential streets, ending in a restaurant parking lot; never faster than about 60 km/h.

privacy.notes: Reviewed 2 frames/fragment (19 frames) at 640px + two full-res crops. Plates on cars stopped ahead at lights (a white Infiniti) and on a parked Mercedes SUV in the lot at the end (fragments 8-9, legible at 1280x720). A family (2 adults, 3 children) crossing at a crosswalk in fragment 6 is small and not identifiable at 1:1. Shipped as-is per the user's Q11 decision (2026-10-01).
